items.summary: Well-known pharmaceutical companies such as  Merck  and  Pfizer  typically manage this complex process in house.  Medpace Holdings  which targets oncology, metabolic, cardiology, central nervous system, and anti-infective therapies, raised its 2026 revenue guidance on July’s second-quarter conference call to a midpoint of $2.85 billion, corresponding to a year-over-year increase of 13%.  Three months later, Medpace is in the pink: On the heels of second-quarter earnings, the stock is up 14%.
